name: Ogre Head On A Stick = Party
summary: At Dreadmaul Rock, you are asked to set Gor'tesh's severed head atop a pike. A soft mound of earth marks where it can be planted.

sections.title: At Dreadmaul Rock
sections.body: Gor'tesh's severed head is meant to be set at the summit of Dreadmaul Rock. You are asked to place it there on a pike, planted in soft earth.

faq.q: What am I supposed to place at Dreadmaul Rock?
faq.answer: You are asked to place Gor'tesh's severed head atop a pike at Dreadmaul Rock.

faq.q: Where do I plant the pike?
faq.answer: Look for a soft mound of dirt at Dreadmaul Rock and plant the pike there.

attribution: In-game quest text: Ogre Head On A Stick = Party
